basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer | Data Visualisation & Developer Tools
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 20+ years of experience spanning data visualisation, reusable libraries, developer tools, and high-performance financial and scientific computing. Strong TypeScript and JavaScript expertise, with experience designing developer-facing APIs, building complex browser interactions, and optimising performance-sensitive software. Author of open-source UI and visualisation libraries used in production by the Vega trading network. Strong mathematical grounding, with degrees from Cambridge and Oxford. Hands-on across architecture, implementation, and production delivery.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Working across browser-based graph, timeline, and geospatial visualisation SDKs, developer experience, and tooling.
highlights: Designed frontend architectures and developer-facing APIs for interactive visualisations operating over large, complex datasets.
Worked on graph layout algorithms, hit-testing, and timeline aggregation.

Built and optimised browser interactions involving large stateful data models and performance-sensitive rendering across Canvas and WebGL pipelines. The SDKs support charts of 40,000+ items at interactive frame rates.
Contributed to technical and product decisions across rendering, animation, state management, API design, and developer experience.
Led the design and build of a unified documentation and examples website for four SDK products, consolidating per-product sites and tooling into one codebase and delivery pipeline.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Independent consultancy building interactive visualisation systems, data-driven applications, and open-source developer tools. Sole engineer on client engagements, responsible for architecture, implementation, and production delivery.
highlights: Created and maintained [Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/), an open-source React split-pane layout component with 200,000+ weekly downloads.

Created [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/), an open-source Canvas-based financial charting library (candlesticks, depth charts, real-time streaming data, panning, zooming, and crosshair interactions), used in production by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.
Designed reusable APIs and abstractions for complex interactive interfaces, balancing flexibility, performance, and developer usability.
Developed an interactive floor-planning application for home-renovation startup [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/).
Designed and delivered data visualisation tools for pensions technology company [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).
Owned projects from requirements and initial design through implementation, deployment, and support, working directly with clients to make technical and product decisions.

work.name: Redgate
work.position: Software Developer, then Trainee Product Manager
work.summary: Built SQL Server database deployment tooling before moving into product management for an acquired database deployment product.
highlights: Developed developer-facing features to improve the reliability and usability of database deployment within CI/CD pipelines.
Used customer research and in-product analytics to prioritise product and UX improvements that increased adoption.

work.name: SunGard
work.summary: Developed infrastructure for high-performance financial risk analytics.
highlights: Developed a tracing JIT compiler that enabled existing C# financial models to execute on GPUs without rewriting the models.
Contributed to the scalable execution framework underpinning financial risk calculations.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Engineering and research roles in high-performance computing, scientific computing, and financial systems.
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at [Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.co.uk/), building computationally intensive systems for financial services.
Application Engineer at [MathWorks](https://www.mathworks.com/), serving as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools and helping developers solve complex computational problems.
Research Scientist at [QinetiQ](https://www.qinetiq.com/), developing tracking and estimation algorithms (Kalman filtering, multi-target tracking) for multi-sensor fusion and defence systems.
